description: This Java class 'UserPrincipal' implements Spring Security's UserDetails interface, serving as a custom user details object that encapsulates user information and authorities for security purposes.

classes.name: UserPrincipal
classes.description: Custom implementation of UserDetails wrapping User and associated AuthGroups to provide user authentication and authorization details for Spring Security.

methods.name: UserPrincipal
methods.description: Constructor initializing UserPrincipal with User and AuthGroup list.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Returns a collection of GrantedAuthority derived from AuthGroups.

methods.name: isAccountNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the account has expired.

methods.name: isAccountNonLocked
methods.description: Indicates whether the account is locked.

methods.name: isCredentialsNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the user's credentials have expired.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the user is enabled.
